## Definition

I treated a protein as **liver-enriched** when its HPA **Tissue expression cluster** contained “Liver” (including joint clusters such as “Brain & Liver” and “Liver & Kidney”). Proteins were included only when both immunoassay and mass-spectrometry blood concentrations were positive and available.

## Group comparison

|---|---:|---:|
| Liver-enriched | 116 | 9.913781556 |
| Rest | 200 | 6.618016574 |

**Difference in medians, liver-enriched − rest: 3.295764982 log10(pg/L)**  
This corresponds to approximately a **1,975-fold** higher median MS concentration in the liver-enriched group.

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# df should contain one row per included protein with these columns:
# Gene, im, ms, grp
#

df["log10_im"] = np.log10(df["im"])
df["log10_ms"] = np.log10(df["ms"])

}

        sub["log10_im"],

        alpha=0.75,
        label=f"{group} (n={len(sub)})",
        color=colors[group],
        edgecolor="none"
    )

lims = [
    min(df["log10_ms"].min(), df["log10_im"].min()),
    max(df["log10_ms"].max(), df["log10_im"].max())
]
ax.plot(lims, lims, "--", color="gray", linewidth=1)

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 7), sharex=False)

for ax, group in zip(axes, ["Liver-enriched", "Rest"]):
    top = (
        df[df["grp"] == group]
        .nlargest(10, "log10_ratio")
        .sort_values("log10_ratio")
    )

    ax.barh(
        top["Gene"],
        top["log10_ratio"],
        color=colors[group]

    ax.axvline(0, color="black", linewidth=0.8)
